title: Compass
about: Four directions at every node (origin, effect, what is said about it, what it mentions), under a perspective, with facets, grouping, depth and named questions. Builds and verifies the graph with the kernel wasm and reads the predicate terms from the same records.

graph@1.answer: {records, keys, names} only: a graph built elsewhere ({graph}) is refused, the compass needs the records for the terms

files: its own pinned files: runtime/wasm/ (manifest.json, the .wasm) and sketches/<sketch>.json, fetched from the viewer's origin (the leaf CSP needs connect-src for that origin; tests/e2e/leaf-csp.mjs)

focus.about: the node to stand on; a hash prefix is accepted

facets.about: {facet: [values]} for facets the sketch declares; others are refused by name

g.about: a grouping id the sketch declares; '' = none

navigate.about: the reader walked to a node (node)

intents.graph: {kind:'graph', node} - an act: show the same place in the graph viewer (the host opens it; as a page it navigates there itself)
intents.reveal: {kind:'reveal', …} - the reader asked to show what the perspective hides

handover.v3: a frame with no ?union=: kton:ready, then kton:request graph@1 after the first kton:set (core/leaf.js)
handover.static: ?union=<url> with sibling keys.json/names.json, or the fixture picker
